Key Concepts:
 1. Assessment data is clustered and
organized according to possible
nutrition diagnoses.
 2. Wherever possible, amounts of key 
nutrients are estimated.
 3. Appropriate standards are applied
to evaluate the data.
Step 2: Nutrition Diagnosis
PES #1: Excessive energy intake re-
lated to daily intake of whole-fat dairy 
products, desserts, and large meat por-
tions as evidenced by average caloric
intake of 3200 kcal @ 150% in excess
of estimated needs of 2100–2200 kcal.
PES #2: Excessive saturated fat intake
related to daily intake of whole-fat
dairy products and large meat portions
as evidenced by saturated fat intake
of 36 @ 10% of total kcal compared to
recommended 7% of kcal.
PES #3: Excessive sodium intake relat-
ed to daily consumption of convenience
and fast foods as evidenced by typical
daily sodium intake of 3500–4500 mg
compared to recommended 2400 mg
